meta_description:
219 likes, 20 comments - ilunarang on January 2, 2026: "Share this with your travel partner 😍 
I've travelled to ✅ 20 states and 6 union territories in India and here's the list of best places to visit according to the weather conditions.

Jan- Kashmir to see frozen waterfall
Feb- Manipur to stay on floating cottage in the middle of Loktak lake
Mar- Rishikesh for Holi
Apr- Sikkim to see the frozen Tsomgo lake
May- Pench national park
June- Nagaland to trek to the "valley of the dead"- Dzukou valley
July- Kasol to enjoy early monsoon and pleasant weather 
Aug and Sep- are the best time to visit Ladakh. There are so many beautiful places to visit 
Oct- Hippie island in hampi has great mud houses to experience that rural life
Nov- Gokarna has great beaches and cafés for a tropical vacation
Dec- Goa has lots of great events in December and the weather is just perfect

➡️ Share this with someone you'd like to visit these places

✅ Follow my page for part 2 where I will show lots of other incredible places in India

#indiangirlstravel #placestovisitinindia #travellingindia #indiaunseen #loktaklake".
